note: Fake sample story written for this demo. Not a real post, not copied from any source.

shots.narration: I moved into the flat in March, and the hallway light was the first thing I fixed.
shots.on_screen: Narrator in hallway, hallway light on, door closed at the far end.

shots.narration: On the third night the light went out at 3:03, and it came back on by itself.
shots.on_screen: Same hallway, same rig and set, light off, then light on.

shots.narration: I left the door open that night so I could hear it, and I heard the handle turn.
shots.on_screen: Hallway door ajar, handle in frame, narrator listening.

shots.narration: In the kitchen I found a note on the counter, in my own handwriting, and I had not written it.
shots.on_screen: Kitchen counter, paper note in close view, narrator at the edge of frame.

shots.narration: The note said to leave the light on, so I did, and the flat stayed quiet for a week.
shots.on_screen: Same kitchen rig and set, note still on the counter, light on.

shots.narration: This morning the light was off again, and the note was gone.
shots.on_screen: Hallway in morning light, light off, counter note missing in the final still.

title: DEMO ONLY: The Hallway Light
